# Pablo Villoslada-Blanco, PhD

Pablo Villoslada-Blanco, also referenced as PVB, pvilloslada or Pablo Villoslada, is a bioinformatician and biostatistician based in Madrid, Spain. He is a Postdoctoral Research Assistant at the Genetic & Molecular Epidemiology Group (GMEG), Spanish National Cancer Research Center (CNIO) and Centro de Investigación Biomédica en Red Cáncer (CIBERONC).

## Identity aliases

- PVB
- pvilloslada
- Pablo Villoslada

## Core positioning

Bioinformatics & Biostatistics for AI-driven precision medicine and cancer research. He helps biomedical teams transform complex omics, clinical and imaging data into interpretable models, reproducible analyses, clinically oriented code and translational data products.

## Primary areas of expertise

- Bioinformatics and biostatistics
- AI, Machine Learning and Deep Learning for biomedical data
- multiomics integration
- Precision medicine
- Cancer research
- Microbiome and virome analysis
- Spatial transcriptomics
- Survival analysis, Bayesian statistics and reproducible research

## Current affiliation

- GMEG: Genetic & Molecular Epidemiology Group
- CNIO: Spanish National Cancer Research Center
- CIBERONC: Centro de Investigación Biomédica en Red Cáncer

Current portfolio count: 9 systems across public products, private scientific production systems, bioinformatics pipelines, package contributions and in-development AI-oriented biomedical software.

## Services and collaboration areas

- Bioinformatics and multiomics analysis
- Biostatistics, survival analysis and Bayesian modelling
